{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ecclessis Figg Variation''' was a variation of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] named after [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]] in which, in the final round, all odd-numbered face cards had their scores subtracted rather than added to the total score.
